validation_rules: outputs/license-inventory.json must satisfy license-inventory.schema.json; cross-record rules and the on-disk bindings are sbom_family_contracts.verify_license_attempt

each record carries a licence expression or a closed state (spdx-expression, unknown, no-assertion) and the SOURCE of the claim: declared-in-manifest or found-in-file, with path, sha256 and line span; the file is re-hashed in the source snapshot and a line span must lie inside it

a licence expression has the SHAPE of an SPDX expression: identifiers joined by AND, OR or WITH with balanced parentheses; two identifiers side by side is prose and is rejected (the identifiers themselves are not checked against the SPDX licence list)
declared-in-manifest needs a recognised manifest file and a declared SBOM component; copyright-statement-detected carries no expression and no holder text

vendored-component-inferred means 'not declared in any manifest, inferred from bundled licence or copyright evidence': it is found-in-file, and its component_ref is null or an inferred-vendored SBOM component, never a declared one

the inventory is bound to the SBOM it was computed against: sbom_binding must equal the caller's expected SBOM attempt and sha256, the SBOM bytes are re-hashed before they are parsed, and every non-null component_ref resolves into it
no legal conclusion: no compatibility, compliance, obligation, category, risk, approval or policy verdict can be represented, and such a property is rejected by name
scan-coverage-gap is asserted only by coverage.json
tool-results.json and coverage.json must satisfy tool_instance_shapes.validate_node_aggregate with no probe receipt: this node is always applicable and SKIPPED is never a permitted status

outputs/redaction-receipt.json is required and must verify with evidence_redaction.verify_receipt against the outputs/ directory under the policy and limits the consumer demands, BEFORE any published document is parsed; if it does not verify nothing else is read and only the receipt's errors are reported

the receipt must list every other outputs/ contract file as published (unchanged or redacted, never withheld) and the bytes validated must hash to the receipt's published_sha256; every published document's redactor block must equal the receipt's

status.json carries exactly status, run_id and attempt_id plus, optionally, job_id and dagster_run_id; every one is bound to a caller-supplied fact (node status, expected header, the contract's job id, expected_dagster_run_id) and nothing from it is ever quoted
manifest.json is exactly {schema: appsec-review/attempt-manifest/1, contract_id, outputs[{path, sha256}]}, sorted, naming exactly the regular files beneath outputs/ with the sha256 of their bytes
run_id, job_id, attempt_id and source_snapshot_sha256 must equal the caller's expected header in every published document

every record's tool_id must resolve to a tool instance with a validated output in tool-results.json, its citation must name one of that instance's listed outputs with the same attempt id and sha256, and a tool cannot be cited for more records than its result_record_count
no error message quotes a value read from the attempt; messages name files, fields, ordinal record ids and what the caller expected
a clean or empty result is not evidence of absence; the result cannot promote a lead to a finding, a severity, or an observed runtime state
latest failed attempt blocks older accepted output
